config.name: container
config.description: The element the canvas fills. Size it with CSS; the globe follows it.

config.name: mode
config.description: Projection selector reserved for future map support; the renderer currently builds a sphere for both values. Default `'sphere'`.

config.name: kind
config.description: Visual identity of the rendered globe. Each kind owns its renderer pipeline + per-kind tokens + per-kind config. Defaults to the kind registered for the active theme preset (`outline-*` → `'outline'`, `'dotted-dark'` → `'dotted'`, `'wireframe-tron'` → `'wireframe'`), falling back to `'outline'` for custom themes.

config.name: theme
config.description: Built-in or registered preset name, or `{ extends, tokens }` for token overrides. Omitted uses the base token set; selecting a kind does not automatically select its preset.

config.name: countries
config.description: Country geometry resolution, hover behaviour and per-instance border and fill styling.

children.name: resolution
children.description: Which country geometry loads: `'low'` (about 90 kB), `'medium'` or `'high'`. Default `'medium'`.

children.name: hoverEnabled
children.description: Pick and highlight the country under the pointer. Default true.

children.name: hoverOccludeBackSide
children.description: When true (default), the hover highlight respects the globe's depth — the back-side portions of a country (e.g. the part wrapped around the far side) are hidden. Set to false for an "x-ray" feel where the entire country outline is always visible.

children.name: borderHover
children.description: Per-instance overrides for the hovered country's stroke + additive glow halo. Each field is independent — set what you want to change, leave the rest. Empty-string color / non-positive numeric = "use theme token" sentinel (matches the pattern used elsewhere).

children.name: color
children.description: Hovered-country stroke color. Omitted or empty uses `countries.borderHover.color`.

children.name: width
children.description: Hovered stroke width in CSS pixels. Non-positive or omitted uses `countries.borderHover.width`.

children.name: opacity
children.description: Hovered stroke opacity. Non-positive or omitted uses `countries.borderHover.opacity`.

children.name: glowColor
children.description: Hover-halo color. Omitted or empty uses `countries.borderHover.glowColor`.

children.name: glowWidth
children.description: Hover-halo stroke width in CSS pixels. Non-positive or omitted uses `countries.borderHover.glowWidth`.

children.name: glowOpacity
children.description: Hover-halo opacity. Non-positive or omitted uses `countries.borderHover.glowOpacity`.

children.name: borderActive
children.description: Per-instance overrides for the pinned/active country's stroke. Same sentinel semantics as `borderHover`.

children.name: color
children.description: Pinned-country stroke color. Omitted or empty uses `countries.borderActive.color`.

children.name: width
children.description: Pinned-country stroke width in CSS pixels. Non-positive or omitted uses `countries.borderActive.width`.

children.name: opacity
children.description: Pinned-country stroke opacity. Non-positive or omitted uses `countries.borderActive.opacity`.

children.name: fill
children.description:
Country fill layer config. Independent of strokes — paints the country shape with a solid color.

Modes:
- `'none'` — layer hidden (default; matches the legacy "wait for setData / setDataLayer choropleth" behaviour).
- `'always'` — every country shown with `defaultColor` × `defaultOpacity`.
- `'palette'` — every country picks `palette[index % palette.length]` (stable order from the loaded features array).
- `'data'` — driven by `setData(map, scale?)` / choropleth data layer.

State overrides recolor a single country in place; active wins over hover when both target the same country.

children.name: mode
children.description: Shared fill source: hidden, one color, per-country palette or bound data. `setCountryData()` selects data mode. Default `'none'`.

children.name: defaultColor
children.description: Fallback fill color. Omitted uses `countries.fill.defaultColor`, or `cinematic.landColor` in cinematic mode.

children.name: defaultOpacity
children.description: Fallback fill opacity. Omitted uses `countries.fill.opacity`.

children.name: palette
children.description: Country colors assigned cyclically in geometry feature order for palette mode.

children.name: hoverColor
children.description: Hovered-country fill override. Empty or omitted keeps the base color.

children.name: hoverOpacity
children.description: Hovered-country fill opacity override. Non-positive or omitted keeps the base opacity.

children.name: activeColor
children.description: Pinned-country fill override, taking precedence over hover. Empty or omitted keeps the base color.

children.name: activeOpacity
children.description: Pinned-country fill opacity override. Non-positive or omitted keeps the base opacity.

config.name: countryLabels
config.description: HTML country-name labels with size and occlusion fading. Disabled until `enabled` is true.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Show the labels. Default false.

children.name: color
children.description: Override the theme-driven label text color. CSS-style hex / rgb / rgba string. Falls back to `tokens['countries.label.color']`.

children.name: fontSize
children.description: Override the theme-driven font size (CSS pixels). Falls back to `tokens['countries.label.fontSize']`.

children.name: fontWeight
children.description: Override the theme-driven font weight (e.g. `'500'`, `'700'`, `'bold'`). Falls back to `tokens['countries.label.fontWeight']`.

children.name: labels
children.description: Per-id override map; missing ids fall back to the source `feature.name`.

children.name: minScreenSize
children.description: Minimum apparent screen-pixel size of a country before its label appears. Higher = stricter (fewer labels at any given zoom). Default 60.

children.name: sizeFadeRange
children.description: Width of the smoothstep band (as a fraction of `minScreenSize`) over which the label fades from invisible to fully visible. 0 = hard cutoff, 1 = fades start at zero size. Default 0.4 (label is fully on by `minScreenSize`, fully off below `minScreenSize * 0.6`).

children.name: occlusionFade
children.description: Occlusion smoothstep edges (`facing` = dot product of country normal with camera direction). Defaults `[-0.05, 0.15]` — labels remain visible just past the silhouette and fade in fully once the country has rotated a hair toward the camera. Pass `[0, 0]` for a hard cutoff at the silhouette.

children.name: transitionMs
children.description: Fade-in / fade-out duration in milliseconds, applied as a CSS `transition: opacity Xms ease-out`. Default 200. Set to 0 to snap.

children.name: halo
children.description: Optional CSS halo around each label (a thicker, blurred outline that keeps the text legible against any base color). Drawn via stacked `text-shadow` calls so it works without a canvas pass. When provided, **replaces** the theme `countries.label.textShadow` token.

children.name: color
children.description: Text-halo color. Default `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65)`.

children.name: radius
children.description: Halo radius in CSS pixels. Default 2.

children.name: steps
children.description: Number of stacked shadow copies (more = denser halo). Default 4.

children.name: padding
children.description: Inner padding around label text in CSS pixels. Labels do not handle pointer interaction. Default 0.

config.name: countryData
config.description: Initial per-country colours and values, keyed by zero-padded ISO 3166-1 numeric id. Same shape as `setCountryData()`.

config.name: markers
config.description: Initial pins. Replace or edit later with `setMarkers()`, `addMarker()` and `removeMarker()`.

config.name: htmlMarkers
config.description: Initial DOM-anchored markers.

config.name: arcs
config.description: Initial great-circle connections.

config.name: atmosphere
config.description: The Fresnel rim glow. Rendered unless `enabled` is `false`.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Render the rim glow. Default true.

children.name: color
children.description: Override the theme-driven Fresnel halo color. Any CSS-style hex / rgb / rgba string. Falls back to `tokens['atmosphere.color']`.

children.name: intensity
children.description: Absolute halo-intensity override. Omitted or non-positive values restore the theme intensity; use `enabled: false` to hide it.

children.name: radiusScale
children.description: Shell radius as a multiplier of the globe radius; values at or below 1 restore the layer default. Defaults to 1.18 for dotted, 1.075 for cinematic and 1.15 for the other kinds.

children.name: power
children.description: Fresnel exponent. 0.5 = soft / diffuse glow filling most of the silhouette; 4.0 = razor-thin rim hugging the edge. Default 2.0.

children.name: threshold
children.description: Kind-specific threshold shaping the halo falloff. The shared Fresnel shell uses it as the normal-facing offset; dotted uses a silhouette threshold. Default 0.6.

children.name: side
children.description: Shell render side for outline, wireframe, paper and hologram. Dotted ignores it; cinematic always renders the front-facing shell. Default `'back'` for the shared halo.

children.name: blending
children.description: Blend mode. `'additive'` (default) reads as glow on dark themes; `'normal'` is a flat overlay that avoids highlight blowouts on cream / paper themes.

children.name: pulse
children.description: Optional time-driven brightness oscillation (atmospheric "breath").

children.name: enabled
children.description: Oscillate atmosphere brightness. Default false.

children.name: speed
children.description: Frequency in Hz. Default 0.25 (slow).

children.name: amplitude
children.description: Amplitude as a fraction of base intensity. Default 0.25.

config.name: focusPulse
config.description:
Cross-kind behaviour for the focus-pulse decoration. Visual style still comes from each kind's `focusPulse` decorator (see `kinds/shared/focus- pulse-decorators.ts`); this section governs *when* and *where* the pulse fires regardless of kind.

- `origin` — `'centroid'` (default) fires from the focused country's centroid via `globe.focusOnCountry()`. `'click'` instead uses the exact lat/lng the user just clicked, falling back to the centroid if no recent click was recorded.
- `pulseOnSurfaceClick` — when true, additionally fire a pulse on *any* surface click that doesn't land on a country (e.g. clicks on ocean / wireframe void). Default false.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Master enable. When false, no kind spawns its pulse decorator. Default true.

children.name: origin
children.description: Use the focused country's centroid or a recent click coordinate as pulse origin. Default `'centroid'`.

children.name: pulseOnSurfaceClick
children.description: Also fire the pulse on ocean or other surface clicks outside a country. Default false.

config.name: dotted
config.description: Options read only when `kind` is `'dotted'`.

children.name: clickRipple
children.description: Expanding brightness wave through the dots after a surface click.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Enable click-triggered dot ripples. Default true.

children.name: boost
children.description: Brightness added at the ripple wavefront. Defaults to `countries.dotted.rippleBoost`.

children.name: speed
children.description: Wavefront angular speed in radians per second. Defaults to `countries.dotted.rippleSpeed`.

children.description: Angular width of the bright wavefront in radians. Defaults to `countries.dotted.rippleWidth`.

children.description: Maximum overlapping click ripples; the oldest is reused at capacity. Default 3.

children.name: color
children.description: Empty string = use base dot color brightened.

children.name: dataFlash
children.description: Brief dot-brightness flash when a country's bound data changes.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Flash dots when `setCountryData()` adds an entry or changes its numeric value. Default true.

children.name: strength
children.description: Initial flash brightness boost. Defaults to `countries.dotted.flashStrength`.

children.name: decay
children.description: Exponential fade rate per second; larger values fade faster. Defaults to `countries.dotted.flashDecay`.

children.name: color
children.description: Empty string = use the white-default flash color from tokens.

children.name: drift
children.description: Ambient drift wave — `sin(dot(position, axis) * freq - elapsed * speed)` added to per-dot brightness, very small amplitude so it feels like the globe is breathing rather than strobing. Default-on.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Animate the ambient wave through the dot field. Default true.

children.name: amplitude
children.description: Ambient-wave brightness amplitude. Defaults to `countries.dotted.driftAmplitude`.

children.name: speed
children.description: Ambient-wave phase speed in radians per second. Defaults to `countries.dotted.driftSpeed`.

children.name: freq

children.name: axis
children.description: `'ns'` = north-south wave (drift along Y axis); `'ew'` = east-west; `'both'` = a diagonal axis that mixes the two for moiré-like patterns.

children.name: perCountryPhase
children.description: When true (default), each country's drift wave is rotated by a deterministic hash of its index so adjacent countries breathe at slightly different times rather than strobing in unison. The dotted-only "every country has its own pulse" personality.

children.name: hoverDots
children.description: Hover dot expansion — when a country is hovered, its dots scale up and brighten, easing in/out smoothly. Default-on.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Apply hover brightness, scale and lift to the hovered country's dots. Default true.

children.name: scale
children.description: Hovered-dot size multiplier. Defaults to `countries.dotted.hoverScale`.

children.name: brightnessBoost
children.description: Brightness added to hovered dots. Defaults to `countries.dotted.hoverBrightnessBoost`.

children.name: duration
children.description: Hover transition duration in seconds. Defaults to `countries.dotted.hoverDuration`.

children.name: lift

GlobeKind.name: GlobeKind
GlobeKind.description:
Globe kinds — the high-level visual identity of the rendered globe. Each kind owns its renderer pipeline + per-kind tokens + per-kind config.

- `dotted` — Apple/Stripe-style: glowing dots fill each country, no borders
- `wireframe` — Tron-style: pure lat/lng grid, no country geometry
- `hologram` — sci-fi command-deck: transparent shell, scanlines, Fresnel rim
- `cinematic` — marketing/night-earth: physically lit ocean, city lights, luminous borders and data-network overlays

Future kinds: `paper`, `choropleth`. New kinds get a `kinds/<name>/` folder with their own layer + index.ts exporting a `KindModule`, then a registry entry in `kinds/registry.ts`.

HeatmapDataLayer.name: HeatmapDataLayer
HeatmapDataLayer.description: Density samples baked into an equirectangular texture and rendered on a latitude/longitude sphere. Color follows a palette texture; maxHeight optionally displaces vertices for relief.

members.name: type
members.description: Select the heatmap data-layer renderer.

members.name: data
members.description: Positioned density samples with optional country ids, radius, weight and animation delay.

members.name: scale
members.description: Color palette sampled over normalized density from 0 to 1. Use a matching scale domain; raw sample values are not passed directly to this palette.

members.name: radius
members.description: Default sample influence radius in radians. Default 0.1.

members.name: maxHeight
members.description: Max vertex displacement (world units; 1 = globe radius) at peak density. Default 0. Set to a small value such as 0.04–0.10 for a professional 3D relief; large values quickly dominate the globe.

members.name: subdivisions
members.description: Reserved legacy subdivision option; the current renderer ignores it. Use meshResolution to control displacement geometry.

members.name: kernel
members.description: Kernel shape — see {@link HeatmapKernel}. Default `'gaussian'`.

members.name: textureResolution
members.description: Resolution of the density texture (equirectangular). Higher = sharper detail in tight clusters; costs more bake time + GPU memory. Default 2048×1024 (~8MB). 4096×2048 for hero shots, 1024×512 for live updates.

children.name: width
children.description: Density-texture width in pixels. Default 2048.

children.name: height
children.description: Density-texture height in pixels. Default 1024.

members.name: blendMode
members.description:
How the heatmap composites with the underlying globe surface.
- `'normal'` (default) — opaque-style alpha blend; vivid, professional. Looks like deck.gl HeatmapLayer / Mapbox heatmaps.
- `'additive'` — adds onto the surface; produces glow / neon look, great for night-style globes and hotspot reveals.

members.name: blurPasses
members.description: Post-bake blur passes applied to the density texture (3×3 box blur, separable). Smooths over pixel-level discontinuities at high subdivisions or low texture resolutions. Default 2. 0 disables.

members.name: normalize
members.description: Density normalisation — see {@link HeatmapNormalize}. Default `'peak'`.

members.name: absoluteMax
members.description: Saturation density for absolute normalization. Omitted falls back to the current peak; supply a fixed positive value for comparisons across updates.

members.name: threshold
members.description: Cutoff fraction of peak density (0..1). Pixels below this threshold render fully transparent — sharpens the hotspots and reveals the underlying globe in cooler regions. Default 0.

members.name: intensity
members.description: Multiplier on normalised density before the curve. >1 pushes mids toward saturation; <1 dampens. Default 1.

members.name: curve
members.description: Response curve for COLOUR — see {@link HeatmapCurve}. Default `'smoothstep'`.

members.name: displacementCurve
members.description: Response curve for DISPLACEMENT only. Decoupled from `curve` so the 3D shape can read smoothly (bell-like) even when colour uses a sharp curve (cubic) for crisp hotspots. Defaults to whatever `curve` is set to. For pro-grade 3D peaks set this to `'smoothstep'` or `'sqrt'` to avoid plateaus where many density values saturate to 1.

members.name: meshResolution
members.description: Override the displacement mesh subdivision (longitudinal × latitudinal segments). Higher = smoother peaks at zoom-in, costs vertex shader work. Auto-promoted from 256×128 → 1024×512 when `maxHeight > 0` unless explicitly set here. For hero 3D shots try 2048×1024.

children.name: width
children.description: Longitudinal mesh segments. Defaults to 1024 with positive maxHeight, otherwise 256.

children.name: height
children.description: Latitudinal mesh segments. Defaults to 512 with positive maxHeight, otherwise 128.

members.name: lightDirection
members.description: Light source direction in world space (normalised, doesn't have to sum to 1). Drives the analytical Lambert shading on the displaced surface. Default `[1, 0.6, 0.7]`. Only matters when `maxHeight > 0`.

members.name: shading
members.description: Strength of Lambert shading on the displaced surface. 0 = unlit (flat colour), 1 = full directional shading. Default 0.6 — keeps colour vivid while giving peaks visible volume.

members.name: paletteSteps
members.description: Palette texture resolution — controls colour banding. Default 256. Bump to 512 for very smooth gradients; drop to 16/32 for stepped/topo.

members.name: grid
members.description: Procedural lat/lng grid drawn inside the heatmap shader. Useful for high-density 3D views where the colour field needs surface texture and perspective cues. `false` disables it explicitly.

members.name: contours
members.description: Topographic contour lines drawn from the shaped density field. `false` disables them explicitly.

members.name: rimFade
members.description: Fade width near the visible limb, expressed as radial facing dot range [0..1]. Values around 0.12–0.20 hide exaggerated horizon silhouettes while preserving the centre of the globe. Default 0.

members.name: zoomScaling
members.description: View-dependent relief scaling. This does not rebake density; it only adjusts shader uniforms each frame. `false` disables it explicitly.

members.name: countryDomes
members.description: Rasterize matching `HeatmapDataEntry.id` / `.name` samples inside country polygons as bounded domes. If the active globe kind cannot provide country geometry, or an entry cannot be matched, the layer falls back to the normal radial kernel for that entry.

members.name: animation
members.description: Optional mount animation; omitted or false shows the final state immediately. True enables a 1200 ms rise; an object customizes timing and easing.

members.name: events
members.description: Reserved callback configuration; continuous heatmaps currently do not dispatch sample pointer events.

members.name: position
members.description: Sample latitude and longitude in degrees, also used when no country polygon matches.

members.name: value
members.description: Sample density contribution before weight and optional country-dome pre-scaling.

members.name: id
members.description: Optional country id used by country-aware heatmap modes.

members.name: name
members.description: Optional country name used by country-aware heatmap modes.

members.name: radius
members.description: Per-sample influence radius (rad) override. Falls back to layer radius.

members.name: weight
members.description: Per-sample weight multiplier. Default 1.

members.name: animation
members.description: Per-entry animation override. Only `delay` (relative shift in ms, combined with the layer's `stagger`) and `enabled: false` (skip this entry from the animation entirely) are honoured today; `style`, `easing`, `duration` come from the layer-level config so the GPU LUT stays per-layer. Pass `false` to opt this entry out of animation.

members.name: fill
members.description:
Country fill layer config. Independent of strokes — paints the country shape with a solid color.

Modes:
- `'none'` — layer hidden (default; matches the legacy "wait for setData / setDataLayer choropleth" behaviour).
- `'always'` — every country shown with `defaultColor` × `defaultOpacity`.
- `'palette'` — every country picks `palette[index % palette.length]` (stable order from the loaded features array).
- `'data'` — driven by `setData(map, scale?)` / choropleth data layer.

State overrides recolor a single country in place; active wins over hover when both target the same country.

children.name: mode
children.description: Shared fill source: hidden, one color, per-country palette or bound data. `setCountryData()` selects data mode. Default `'none'`.

children.name: defaultColor
children.description: Fallback fill color. Omitted uses `countries.fill.defaultColor`, or `cinematic.landColor` in cinematic mode.

children.name: defaultOpacity
children.description: Fallback fill opacity. Omitted uses `countries.fill.opacity`.

children.name: palette
children.description: Country colors assigned cyclically in geometry feature order for palette mode.

children.name: hoverColor
children.description: Hovered-country fill override. Empty or omitted keeps the base color.

children.name: hoverOpacity
children.description: Hovered-country fill opacity override. Non-positive or omitted keeps the base opacity.

children.name: activeColor
children.description: Pinned-country fill override, taking precedence over hover. Empty or omitted keeps the base color.

children.name: activeOpacity
children.description: Pinned-country fill opacity override. Non-positive or omitted keeps the base opacity.

CountryLabelsConfig.name: CountryLabelsConfig
CountryLabelsConfig.description: Country name labels rendered as HTML overlays at each country's centroid. Hidden by default — enable explicitly. Small countries fade out when zoomed out (`minScreenSize`); labels on the far side of the globe fade via the same occlusion smoothstep as HTML markers.

members.name: enabled
members.description: Show the labels. Default false.

members.name: color
members.description: Override the theme-driven label text color. CSS-style hex / rgb / rgba string. Falls back to `tokens['countries.label.color']`.

members.name: fontSize
members.description: Override the theme-driven font size (CSS pixels). Falls back to `tokens['countries.label.fontSize']`.

members.name: fontWeight
members.description: Override the theme-driven font weight (e.g. `'500'`, `'700'`, `'bold'`). Falls back to `tokens['countries.label.fontWeight']`.

members.name: labels
members.description: Per-id override map; missing ids fall back to the source `feature.name`.

members.name: minScreenSize
members.description: Minimum apparent screen-pixel size of a country before its label appears. Higher = stricter (fewer labels at any given zoom). Default 60.

members.name: sizeFadeRange
members.description: Width of the smoothstep band (as a fraction of `minScreenSize`) over which the label fades from invisible to fully visible. 0 = hard cutoff, 1 = fades start at zero size. Default 0.4 (label is fully on by `minScreenSize`, fully off below `minScreenSize * 0.6`).

members.name: occlusionFade
members.description: Occlusion smoothstep edges (`facing` = dot product of country normal with camera direction). Defaults `[-0.05, 0.15]` — labels remain visible just past the silhouette and fade in fully once the country has rotated a hair toward the camera. Pass `[0, 0]` for a hard cutoff at the silhouette.

members.name: transitionMs
members.description: Fade-in / fade-out duration in milliseconds, applied as a CSS `transition: opacity Xms ease-out`. Default 200. Set to 0 to snap.

members.name: halo
members.description: Optional CSS halo around each label (a thicker, blurred outline that keeps the text legible against any base color). Drawn via stacked `text-shadow` calls so it works without a canvas pass. When provided, **replaces** the theme `countries.label.textShadow` token.

children.name: color
children.description: Text-halo color. Default `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65)`.

children.name: radius
children.description: Halo radius in CSS pixels. Default 2.

children.name: steps
children.description: Number of stacked shadow copies (more = denser halo). Default 4.

members.name: padding
members.description: Inner padding around label text in CSS pixels. Labels do not handle pointer interaction. Default 0.

CinematicSunConfig.name: CinematicSunConfig
CinematicSunConfig.description:
Sun / light rig for the cinematic kind.

- `fixed` (default) — the light direction is a constant world-space vector (`direction`, falling back to `surface.lightDirection` and then the theme tokens). Auto-rotate orbits the camera, so the lit side stays put in the world.
- `realtime` — the subsolar point is computed from `date` (default: now) and advances with wall-clock time × `timeScale`. Produces the real day/night terminator for that moment.
- `orbit` — time-lapse: the subsolar longitude sweeps westward at `speed` degrees per second (default 6 → one full day every 60 s).

`visible` draws a sun disc + glare far along the light direction (it blooms when it clears the limb).

DottedConfig.name: DottedConfig
DottedConfig.description: Dot-field appearance and interaction effects. Click ripples, data flashes, drift, hover, active-country highlights and cursor wake are enabled by default; latitude bands, breathing and constellation lines are opt-in.

members.name: clickRipple
members.description: Expanding brightness wave through the dots after a surface click.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Enable click-triggered dot ripples. Default true.

children.name: boost
children.description: Brightness added at the ripple wavefront. Defaults to `countries.dotted.rippleBoost`.

children.name: speed
children.description: Wavefront angular speed in radians per second. Defaults to `countries.dotted.rippleSpeed`.

children.name: width
children.description: Angular width of the bright wavefront in radians. Defaults to `countries.dotted.rippleWidth`.

children.name: maxConcurrent
children.description: Maximum overlapping click ripples; the oldest is reused at capacity. Default 3.

children.name: color
children.description: Empty string = use base dot color brightened.

members.name: dataFlash
members.description: Brief dot-brightness flash when a country's bound data changes.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Flash dots when `setCountryData()` adds an entry or changes its numeric value. Default true.

children.name: strength
children.description: Initial flash brightness boost. Defaults to `countries.dotted.flashStrength`.

children.name: decay
children.description: Exponential fade rate per second; larger values fade faster. Defaults to `countries.dotted.flashDecay`.

children.name: color
children.description: Empty string = use the white-default flash color from tokens.

members.name: drift
members.description: Ambient drift wave — `sin(dot(position, axis) * freq - elapsed * speed)` added to per-dot brightness, very small amplitude so it feels like the globe is breathing rather than strobing. Default-on.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Animate the ambient wave through the dot field. Default true.

children.name: amplitude
children.description: Ambient-wave brightness amplitude. Defaults to `countries.dotted.driftAmplitude`.

children.name: speed
children.description: Ambient-wave phase speed in radians per second. Defaults to `countries.dotted.driftSpeed`.

children.name: freq
children.description: Spatial wave frequency across the normalized sphere. Defaults to `countries.dotted.driftFreq`.

children.name: axis
children.description: `'ns'` = north-south wave (drift along Y axis); `'ew'` = east-west; `'both'` = a diagonal axis that mixes the two for moiré-like patterns.

children.name: perCountryPhase
children.description: When true (default), each country's drift wave is rotated by a deterministic hash of its index so adjacent countries breathe at slightly different times rather than strobing in unison. The dotted-only "every country has its own pulse" personality.

members.name: hoverDots
members.description: Hover dot expansion — when a country is hovered, its dots scale up and brighten, easing in/out smoothly. Default-on.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Apply hover brightness, scale and lift to the hovered country's dots. Default true.

children.name: scale
children.description: Hovered-dot size multiplier. Defaults to `countries.dotted.hoverScale`.

children.name: brightnessBoost
children.description: Brightness added to hovered dots. Defaults to `countries.dotted.hoverBrightnessBoost`.

children.name: duration
children.description: Hover transition duration in seconds. Defaults to `countries.dotted.hoverDuration`.

children.name: lift
children.description: Radial lift as a fraction of `GLOBE_RADIUS` — pushes the hovered country's dots outward along the surface normal so the country reads as "rising out of the field" toward the camera. Default 0.008 (≈0.8%). Set to 0 for a hover-without-lift look.

members.name: activeCountry
members.description: Pinned-country pulse — the dotted analogue of the standard `SelectionLayer` active stroke (which dotted opts out of). When `globe.setActiveCountry(id)` runs, the pinned country's dots pick up a steady brightness boost + slow sine pulse. Independent from hover so the user can pin one country and hover another.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Highlight the pinned country's dots independently of hover. Default true.

children.name: boost
children.description: Steady brightness boost added to active dots. Default 0.65.

children.name: scale
children.description: Active-country dot scale multiplier. Default 1.18.

children.name: pulseSpeed
children.description: Sine pulse frequency in Hz. Default 0.65.

children.name: lift
children.description: Radial lift as a fraction of `GLOBE_RADIUS`. Same idea as the hover lift but with a higher default so pinned reads stronger. Default 0.012 (≈1.2%).

members.name: edge
members.description:
Country-edge highlight — extra brightness + radial lift applied only to the surface dots that already sit at the country's silhouette (`aIsEdge` per dot, baked at build time). Replaces the old `borderDots` separate-layer approach: instead of emitting a second dot string at sub-degree spacing (which fights the surface grid and reads as misaligned noise), we just brighten the existing grid dots that trace the boundary.

Active only on the hovered/pinned country — interior dots and non-active countries are unaffected.

children.name: lift
children.description: Extra radial lift applied only to edge-dots on hover/active, stacked on top of `hoverDots.lift` / `activeCountry.lift`. Fraction of GLOBE_RADIUS. Default 0.004.

members.description: Master appearance overrides applied to every dot. Lets callers recolor / resize the entire field without theming, while still letting per-effect colors mix on top.

children.description: Empty string = use theme `countries.dotted.color`.

children.name: sizeScale
children.description: Multiplier on the theme size; 1 = no change, 0 collapses to theme default.

children.name: opacity
children.description: Master opacity; ≤0 = use theme `countries.dotted.opacity`.

children.name: activeColor

children.name: speed

children.name: opacity

PostProcessingConfig.name: PostProcessingConfig
PostProcessingConfig.description:
Shared HDR post-processing pipeline configuration.

The pipeline renders the scene into an off-screen HDR target, extracts a thresholded bright buffer, blurs it through a 5-level dual-Kawase chain (plus a horizontal anamorphic streak), then composites everything back to the canvas with vignette / chromatic aberration / film grain, an exposure multiplier and a soft highlight roll-off (the scene layers are display-referred and tone-map themselves; the composite never applies a second filmic curve).

Every section is optional and merges over the defaults. `enabled` defaults to `true` for the `cinematic` kind and `false` everywhere else.

members.name: enabled
members.description: Master switch. Omit to inherit the per-kind default (`cinematic` opts in, every other kind renders straight to the canvas).

members.name: exposure
members.description: Linear exposure multiplier applied before the highlight roll-off. Default 1.0.

members.name: resolutionScale
members.description: Resolution of the bloom chain relative to the drawing buffer. 0.5 (default) halves it — the blur hides the loss and the fill cost drops 4×.

members.name: bloom
members.description: Blur bright scene regions and add the result as a luminous halo.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Include this effect while the post-processing pipeline is enabled. Default true.

children.name: strength
children.description: How much of the blurred bright buffer is added back. Default 0.48.

children.name: threshold
children.description: Luminance above which pixels start to bloom. Default 0.8.

children.name: radius
children.description: Scales the tent-upsample tap offsets — wider halo. 0..1, default 0.6.

children.name: softKnee
children.description: Softens the threshold knee (fraction of `threshold`). Default 0.5.

members.name: streak
members.description: Horizontal anamorphic streaks from bright regions.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Include this effect while the post-processing pipeline is enabled. Default true.

children.name: strength
children.description: Contribution of the horizontal streak in the composite. Default 0.22.

children.name: length
children.description: Horizontal reach of the streak. 0..1, default 0.55.

children.name: color
children.description: Anamorphic tint. Default `#9fd4ff`.

members.name: vignette
members.description: Darken the frame corners in the composite pass.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Include this effect while the post-processing pipeline is enabled. Default true.

children.name: strength
children.description: Corner darkening amount. 0..1, default 0.32.

children.name: softness
children.description: Widens the falloff towards the centre. 0..1, default 0.45.

members.name: chromaticAberration
members.description: Offset color channels radially near the frame edges.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Include this effect while the post-processing pipeline is enabled. Default true.

children.name: strength
children.description: Radial per-channel UV offset at the frame edge. Default 0.0025.

members.name: grain
members.description: Animated film-grain noise in the final composite.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Include this effect while the post-processing pipeline is enabled. Default true.

children.name: strength
children.description: Film-grain amplitude, attenuated in bright areas. Default 0.035.

children.description: Per-instance overrides for the pinned/active country's stroke. Same sentinel semantics as `borderHover`.

children.name: fill
children.description:
Country fill layer config. Independent of strokes — paints the country shape with a solid color.

Modes:
- `'none'` — layer hidden (default; matches the legacy "wait for setData / setDataLayer choropleth" behaviour).
- `'always'` — every country shown with `defaultColor` × `defaultOpacity`.
- `'palette'` — every country picks `palette[index % palette.length]` (stable order from the loaded features array).
- `'data'` — driven by `setData(map, scale?)` / choropleth data layer.

State overrides recolor a single country in place; active wins over hover when both target the same country.

children.name: palette

children.name: hoverOpacity

members.name: focusPulse
members.description:

children.name: relief

children.name: biomes

children.name: shallows

children.name: moonlight
children.description: Night-side moonlight strength 0..2. Default 1.

children.name: snowLine

children.name: saturation

children.name: iceColor

children.name: vegetationColor

children.name: desertColor

children.name: shallowWaterColor
children.description: Coastal shallow-water tint. Omitted or empty uses `cinematic.shallowWaterColor`.

children.name: mode
children.description: Light-direction source: fixed vector, real-time solar position or animated longitude. Default `'fixed'`.

children.name: direction
children.description: World-space light vector for fixed mode. Defaults to `cinematic.surface.lightDirection`, then the theme direction.

children.name: date
children.description: Initial date for real-time solar position; accepts a Date, date string or Unix milliseconds. Omitted uses the current time.

children.name: timeScale

children.name: color

children.name: size
children.description: Sun-disc size multiplier. Default 1.

children.name: glare

children.name: coverage

children.name: opacity

children.name: speed

children.name: altitude

children.name: shadows

children.name: shadowStrength

children.name: speed
children.description: Curtain animation speed multiplier. Default 1.

children.name: latitude

children.name: twilightColor

children.name: count
children.description: Fallback point count and custom-dataset limit; 0 removes all city points and their density contribution. Default 11500.

children.name: size
children.description: Base city-point size in world units, attenuated by camera distance. Default 0.0058.

children.name: twinkle

children.name: data
children.description: Custom city-light points used for rendering and the density atlas. Omitted or empty uses the built-in distribution.

children.name: routes

children.name: durationMs

children.name: angularRadiusBase

children.name: angularBand

children.name: scaleMin

children.name: scaleMax

children.name: peakOpacity

members.name: dotted
members.description: Options read only when `kind` is `'dotted'`.

children.name: clickRipple
children.description: Expanding brightness wave through the dots after a surface click.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Enable click-triggered dot ripples. Default true.

children.name: boost
children.description: Brightness added at the ripple wavefront. Defaults to `countries.dotted.rippleBoost`.

children.name: speed
children.description: Wavefront angular speed in radians per second. Defaults to `countries.dotted.rippleSpeed`.

children.name: width
children.description: Angular width of the bright wavefront in radians. Defaults to `countries.dotted.rippleWidth`.

children.name: maxConcurrent
children.description: Maximum overlapping click ripples; the oldest is reused at capacity. Default 3.

children.name: color
children.description: Empty string = use base dot color brightened.

children.name: dataFlash
children.description: Brief dot-brightness flash when a country's bound data changes.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Flash dots when `setCountryData()` adds an entry or changes its numeric value. Default true.

children.name: strength
children.description: Initial flash brightness boost. Defaults to `countries.dotted.flashStrength`.

children.name: decay
children.description: Exponential fade rate per second; larger values fade faster. Defaults to `countries.dotted.flashDecay`.

children.name: color
children.description: Empty string = use the white-default flash color from tokens.

children.name: drift
children.description: Ambient drift wave — `sin(dot(position, axis) * freq - elapsed * speed)` added to per-dot brightness, very small amplitude so it feels like the globe is breathing rather than strobing. Default-on.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Animate the ambient wave through the dot field. Default true.

children.name: amplitude
children.description: Ambient-wave brightness amplitude. Defaults to `countries.dotted.driftAmplitude`.

children.name: speed
children.description: Ambient-wave phase speed in radians per second. Defaults to `countries.dotted.driftSpeed`.

children.name: freq
children.description: Spatial wave frequency across the normalized sphere. Defaults to `countries.dotted.driftFreq`.

children.name: axis
children.description: `'ns'` = north-south wave (drift along Y axis); `'ew'` = east-west; `'both'` = a diagonal axis that mixes the two for moiré-like patterns.

children.name: perCountryPhase
children.description: When true (default), each country's drift wave is rotated by a deterministic hash of its index so adjacent countries breathe at slightly different times rather than strobing in unison. The dotted-only "every country has its own pulse" personality.

children.name: hoverDots
children.description: Hover dot expansion — when a country is hovered, its dots scale up and brighten, easing in/out smoothly. Default-on.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Apply hover brightness, scale and lift to the hovered country's dots. Default true.

children.name: scale
children.description: Hovered-dot size multiplier. Defaults to `countries.dotted.hoverScale`.

children.name: brightnessBoost
children.description: Brightness added to hovered dots. Defaults to `countries.dotted.hoverBrightnessBoost`.

children.name: duration
children.description: Hover transition duration in seconds. Defaults to `countries.dotted.hoverDuration`.

children.name: lift
children.description: Radial lift as a fraction of `GLOBE_RADIUS` — pushes the hovered country's dots outward along the surface normal so the country reads as "rising out of the field" toward the camera. Default 0.008 (≈0.8%). Set to 0 for a hover-without-lift look.

children.name: activeCountry
children.description: Pinned-country pulse — the dotted analogue of the standard `SelectionLayer` active stroke (which dotted opts out of). When `globe.setActiveCountry(id)` runs, the pinned country's dots pick up a steady brightness boost + slow sine pulse. Independent from hover so the user can pin one country and hover another.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Highlight the pinned country's dots independently of hover. Default true.

children.name: boost
children.description: Steady brightness boost added to active dots. Default 0.65.

children.name: scale
children.description: Active-country dot scale multiplier. Default 1.18.

children.name: pulseSpeed
children.description: Sine pulse frequency in Hz. Default 0.65.

children.name: lift
children.description: Radial lift as a fraction of `GLOBE_RADIUS`. Same idea as the hover lift but with a higher default so pinned reads stronger. Default 0.012 (≈1.2%).

children.name: edge
children.description:
Country-edge highlight — extra brightness + radial lift applied only to the surface dots that already sit at the country's silhouette (`aIsEdge` per dot, baked at build time). Replaces the old `borderDots` separate-layer approach: instead of emitting a second dot string at sub-degree spacing (which fights the surface grid and reads as misaligned noise), we just brighten the existing grid dots that trace the boundary.

Active only on the hovered/pinned country — interior dots and non-active countries are unaffected.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Master toggle. False zeroes both `boost` and `lift`. Default true.

children.name: boost
children.description: Brightness multiplier added to edge-dots on hover/active. 0 = no rim, just the standard country brightness. Default 0.55.

children.name: lift
children.description: Extra radial lift applied only to edge-dots on hover/active, stacked on top of `hoverDots.lift` / `activeCountry.lift`. Fraction of GLOBE_RADIUS. Default 0.004.

children.name: appearance
children.description: Master appearance overrides applied to every dot. Lets callers recolor / resize the entire field without theming, while still letting per-effect colors mix on top.

children.name: color
children.description: Empty string = use theme `countries.dotted.color`.

children.name: sizeScale
children.description: Multiplier on the theme size; 1 = no change, 0 collapses to theme default.

children.name: opacity
children.description: Master opacity; ≤0 = use theme `countries.dotted.opacity`.

children.name: dots
children.description: Per-country dot colors, independent of the background country-fill mesh. Palette, hover and active colors are supported; the data mode currently falls back to theme colors.

children.name: mode
children.description: Base dot-color source. Palette assigns colors by feature index; data currently falls back to theme colors because no data-to-dot routing is implemented. Default `'theme'`.

children.name: palette
children.description: Country colors assigned by geometry feature index in palette mode. An empty palette keeps the theme color.

children.name: hoverColor
children.description: Color for hovered-country dots; empty or omitted keeps the base color.

children.name: activeColor
children.description: Color for pinned-country dots; takes precedence over hover. Empty or omitted keeps the base color.

children.name: cursorWake
children.description: Cursor wake — small ripple that fades behind the cursor as it moves across the globe surface. Lower-amplitude than clickRipple, so it reads as ambient response rather than impact.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Add a fading brightness trail at the pointer's surface position. Default true.

children.name: amplitude
children.description: Peak brightness multiplier at the wake's center. Default 0.6.

children.name: fade
children.description: Fade-out duration in seconds. Default 0.45.

children.name: width
children.description: Gaussian band half-width in radians. Default 0.09.

children.name: latitudeBands
children.description: Geographic latitude emphasis — equator + tropics get a brightness boost so the dot grid implicitly draws the planet's main parallels. Subtle (low boost) by default; crank it up for atlas-like clarity.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Emphasize dots near the equator and tropics. Default false.

children.name: equatorBoost
children.description: Brightness multiplier added at the equator (lat = 0). Default 0.35.

children.name: tropicsBoost
children.description: Brightness multiplier added at the tropics (lat ≈ ±23.5°). Default 0.18.

children.name: width
children.description: Half-width of each band in degrees of latitude. Default 4.

children.name: pulseBreath
children.description: Whole-field "breath" — global brightness oscillation, like the atmosphere's pulse but on the dots themselves.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Oscillate brightness across the whole dot field. Default false.

children.name: amplitude
children.description: Brightness amplitude (0..1). Default 0.12.

children.name: speed
children.description: Cycles per second. Default 0.35.

children.name: constellation
children.description: Constellation lines — when a country is hovered, draw thin glowing lines connecting nearest-neighbour dots within the country, treating the dot grid as a star chart.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Connect nearby dots inside the hovered country. Default false.

children.name: color
children.description: Empty string = use the base dot color.

children.name: opacity
children.description: Line opacity (0..1). Default 0.55.

children.name: distanceFactor
children.description: Multiplier on the minimum spacing between adjacent dots; lines are drawn between any pair within this many "grid steps" of each other. Default 1.6 — connects each dot to its ring of neighbours.

members.name: wireframe
members.description: Options read only when `kind` is `'wireframe'`.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Reserved master switch; the wireframe kind currently builds its grid regardless of this value. Select `kind: 'wireframe'` to render it.

children.name: density
children.description: Override token-driven density (1 = default, lower = sparser).

children.name: pulse
children.description: Override token-driven pulse amplitude (0..1, 0 = disabled).

children.name: pulseSpeed
children.description: Ambient grid-brightness pulse frequency in cycles per second. Default 0.5.

children.name: color
children.description: Override the base grid line color. Empty string = use theme token. The pulse / boost colors layered on top read from `clickPulse.color` and `gridPulse.color` independently.

children.name: opacity
children.description: 0..1 base opacity — non-positive resets to theme.

children.name: hierarchy
children.description: Major / minor line distinction — primary parallels + meridians (every `majorStepDeg` degrees) render at `majorBoost` * base brightness so the grid reads as a hierarchy, not a uniform mesh. Defaults: stepDeg=30, majorBoost=1.6, minorBoost=0.85, edge thickness handled by the renderer.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Distinguish major and minor grid lines by brightness. Default true.

children.name: majorStepDeg
children.description: Spacing of "major" lines in degrees. Default 30.

children.name: majorBoost
children.description: Brightness multiplier for major lines. Default 1.6.

children.name: minorBoost
children.description: Brightness multiplier for non-major (minor) lines. Default 0.85.

children.name: clickPulse
children.description: Click pulse — radial brightness wave expanding along the grid from any surface click. Tron-style impact feedback.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Spawn expanding grid waves on surface clicks. Default true.

children.name: speed
children.description: Wavefront expansion in radians/sec. Default 1.5.

children.name: width
children.description: Gaussian band half-width in radians. Default 0.18.

children.name: boost
children.description: Peak brightness multiplier at the wavefront. Default 2.5.

children.name: maxConcurrent
children.description: Maximum simultaneous click pulses (older ones recycle). Default 4.

children.name: color
children.description: Override pulse color. Empty string = theme default.

children.name: emphasis
children.description: Geographic emphasis — equator + tropics get 2× brightness; prime meridian + antimeridian get half emphasis. Subtle visual hierarchy.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Highlight the equator, tropics and principal meridians. Defaults to `wireframe.emphasisEnabled`.

children.name: strongColor
children.description: Override the strong (equator + tropics) line color. Empty = theme.

children.name: weakColor
children.description: Override the weak (meridians) line color. Empty = theme.

children.name: strongOpacity
children.description: Strong-line opacity (0..1). Non-positive = theme default.

children.name: weakOpacityFactor
children.description: Weak-line opacity factor (0..1). Default 0.5.

children.name: equatorBeam
children.description: Equator beam — a thicker glowing line at the equator drawn separately from `emphasis`. Reads as a "data spine" running around the planet, can be pulsed for that "live energy" feel.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Show the separate luminous equator beam. Default false.

children.name: color
children.description: Override beam color. Empty string = theme default.

children.name: opacity
children.description: Beam opacity (0..1). Non-positive = default 0.85.

children.name: pulse
children.description: Pulse the beam intensity over time. Default false.

children.name: pulseSpeed
children.description: Beam pulse Hz when `pulse` enabled. Default 0.6.

children.name: glitch
children.description: CRT-glitch transients — every interval seconds, a horizontal band briefly shears laterally then snaps back. Atmosphere, not noise.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Apply occasional lateral grid distortions. Defaults to `wireframe.glitchEnabled`.

children.name: intervalMin
children.description: Lower bound of inter-glitch wait (seconds). Default 5.

children.name: intervalMax
children.description: Upper bound of inter-glitch wait (seconds). Default 15.

children.name: activeRing
children.description: Glowing ring around the centroid of the currently active (pinned) country. Sized to enclose the country's main ring with `padding` margin; rotates slowly around its outward axis. Fades in/out on activate/clear.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Show a rotating ring around the pinned country. Default true.

children.name: rotationSpeed
children.description: Rotation around the outward axis (rad/sec). Default 0.5.

children.name: padding
children.description: Multiplier on the country's angular radius. Default 1.2.

children.name: color
children.description: Override ring color. Empty string = theme default.

children.name: opacity
children.description: Ring opacity (0..1). Non-positive = theme default.

children.name: poleStreams
children.description: Distant data-flow streams — small luminous particles continuously falling from the north pole towards the south pole along random meridians.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Animate particles from north to south along meridians. Default true.

children.name: count
children.description: Number of simultaneously-active particles. Default 16.

children.name: speed
children.description: Southward angular velocity in radians/sec. Default 0.6.

children.name: color
children.description: Override stream color. Empty string = theme default.

children.name: size
children.description: Particle size. Non-positive = theme default.

children.name: opacity
children.description: Stream opacity (0..1). Non-positive = theme default.

children.name: dataPackets
children.description: Data packets — small luminous "blips" that race along latitude / longitude lines as if information was being carried through the grid. Each packet has a short fading trail.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Animate packets travelling along latitude and longitude lines. Default false.

children.name: count
children.description: Total simultaneous packets. Default 24.

children.name: speed
children.description: Travel speed in radians/sec. Default 0.9.

children.name: trail
children.description: Trail length in radians (0 = no trail). Default 0.18.

children.name: size
children.description: Packet point size. Default 0.018.

children.name: color
children.description: Override packet color. Empty string = theme default.

children.name: axis
children.description: Which axis the packets travel along. Default `'both'`.

children.name: compass
children.description: Compass markers — N/S/E/W cardinal letters anchored above the surface at the four cardinal poles (and the two geographic poles). Acts as a "we know where we are" anchor for the viewer.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Show the cardinal-direction markers. Default false.

children.name: color
children.description: Override marker color. Empty string = theme default.

children.name: size
children.description: Cardinal-marker sprite size in world units. Default 0.075.

children.name: opacity
children.description: Opacity (0..1). Non-positive = default 0.9.

children.name: poles
children.description: Show N + S poles in addition to cardinals. Default true.

children.name: gridPulse
children.description: Autonomous grid pulse — like the click pulse, but fires periodically from either a fixed location or a random origin each cycle. Reads as the grid "breathing" or "transmitting" without needing user input.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Emit grid pulses periodically without a click. Default false.

children.name: intervalSec
children.description: Seconds between pulses. Default 4.

children.name: speed
children.description: Wavefront speed (rad/sec). Default 1.2.

children.name: width
children.description: Gaussian band half-width in radians. Default 0.16.

children.name: boost
children.description: Peak brightness multiplier. Default 1.8.

children.name: color
children.description: Override pulse color (empty = uses click-pulse color).

children.name: mode
children.description: `'fixed'` = always from `origin` lat/lng; `'random'` = random sphere point each cycle.

children.name: originLat
children.description: Origin lat (used when `mode === 'fixed'`). Default 0.

children.name: originLng
children.description: Origin lng (used when `mode === 'fixed'`). Default 0.

children.name: polePulse
children.description: Pole pulses — periodic radial waves emanating outward from the geographic poles. Distinct from `poleStreams` (which travel pole→pole along meridians); pole pulses spread around the cap as a halo.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Emit periodic waves from the geographic poles. Default false.

children.name: intervalSec
children.description: Seconds between pulses. Default 5.

children.name: speed
children.description: Wavefront speed in rad/sec. Default 1.0.

children.name: boost
children.description: Peak brightness multiplier. Default 1.5.

children.name: color
children.description: Override pulse color. Empty string = theme default (uses pulse color).

children.name: which
children.description: Which pole(s) to fire from. Default `'both'`.

members.name: paper

children.description: Fallback for `borders.roughness` when that nested option is omitted. Prefer `borders.roughness` for new configurations.

children.name: surface

children.name: color
children.description: Parchment base color. Omitted or empty uses `paper.surfaceColor`.

children.name: noiseAmount
children.description: Random grain intensity in the parchment texture. Defaults to `paper.surfaceNoiseAmount`.

children.name: vignette
children.description: Darkening baked around the parchment texture edges. Default 0.18.

children.name: fiberAmount
children.description: Long fiber-stroke intensity in the parchment texture, from 0 to 1. Default 0.45.

children.name: stainAmount
children.description: Watercolor stain intensity in the parchment texture, from 0 to 1. Default 0.2.

children.name: washColor
children.description: Watercolor stain tint. Omitted or empty uses `#e7b85f`.

children.name: waterLineAmount
children.description: Engraved ocean-hatching intensity, from 0 to 1. Default 0.58.

children.name: waterLineColor
children.description: Ocean-hatching ink color. Omitted or empty uses `#6f9d9a`.

children.name: borders
children.description: Country outlines with optional stippling, deterministic jitter and an ink-bleed pass.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Show the paper country outlines. Default true.

children.name: color
children.description: Border ink color. Omitted or empty uses `paper.borderColor`.

children.name: opacity
children.description: Border opacity. Defaults to `paper.borderOpacity`.

children.name: roughness
children.description: Perpendicular border jitter strength; 0 draws smooth outlines. Defaults to `borderRoughness`, then `paper.borderRoughness`.

children.name: width
children.description: Requested line width; actual wide-line support depends on the WebGL implementation. Default 1.

children.name: stipple
children.description: Replace continuous border strokes with sampled ink dots.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Draw stippled country borders. Default false.

children.name: density
children.description: Angular sampling interval in degrees along border segments; smaller values produce more dots. Default 1.5.

children.name: size
children.description: Ink-dot size multiplier applied to a 0.012-world-unit point size. Default 1.

children.name: inkBleed
children.description: Soft secondary border pass that simulates ink spreading into the paper.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Show the ink-bleed border pass. Default true.

children.name: color
children.description: Bleed tint. Omitted or empty inherits the configured border color.

children.name: opacity

members.name: axisTilt
members.description: Tilt the globe's axis around the Z axis (in degrees, like Earth's 23.5°). Affects only visual appearance — auto-rotate, raycasting, and lat/lng conversions all keep working naturally because everything is rendered inside a tilted parent group. Default 0.

members.name: autoRotate
members.description: Ambient rotation. Off unless `enabled` is `true`.

children.name: enabled

members.name: performance
members.description: Antialiasing, pixel ratio, frame-rate ceiling, adaptive quality and pausing.

children.name: antialias
children.description: Multisample antialiasing on the canvas. Default true.

children.name: pixelRatio
children.description: Device pixel ratio to render at; `'auto'` uses `min(devicePixelRatio, 2)`. Default `'auto'`.

children.name: maxFps
children.description: Frame-rate ceiling for this globe. Every globe on a page shares one animation loop; a decorative globe at 30 keeps rendering smoothly while leaving the budget to the hero. Default 60.

children.name: adaptiveQuality
children.description: Lower the pixel ratio on slow frames and raise it back when the budget allows. Default true.

children.name: pauseWhenHidden
children.description: Stop rendering while the globe is scrolled out of view or the tab is hidden (IntersectionObserver + `visibilitychange`). Time-based animation resumes without a jump. Default true.

members.name: initialPosition
members.description: Initial camera target in degrees. Omitted keeps the camera on world +Z, facing `[0, -90]` with zero axis tilt.

members.description: Closest camera distance in globe radii. Default 1.5.

members.name: maxZoom
members.description: Farthest camera distance in globe radii. Default 6.

members.description: Wheel zoom mode, speed and smoothing. Dedicated pinch zoom is not implemented.

children.name: mode
children.description: How a scroll step moves the camera. Default `'classic'`.

children.name: strength
children.description: 0..1 — intensity of repel/attract correction. Ignored for `classic`. Default 0.5.

children.name: smooth
children.description: When true (default), the camera interpolates smoothly toward its post-scroll target each frame instead of snapping. Applies to all modes.

members.name: transparent
members.description: Render with a transparent canvas — the host page bleeds through. Useful when the globe is decoration on top of a page gradient or background image and you don't want the theme's `background.color` to clip the visual as a square. Default `false`.

members.name: framing
members.description: Initial camera distance derived from vertical field of view and estimated globe extent, with optional fixed zoom limits. Omit padding to retain the initial distance.

children.name: padding
children.description: Extra margin factor around the estimated visible globe extent. Omitted skips reframing; explicit 0 fits the base halo estimate and positive values add breathing room.

children.name: lockZoom
children.description: Use the computed framing distance for omitted zoom limits, preventing zoom in either direction when neither limit is explicit. Explicit minZoom or maxZoom takes precedence. Default false.

HeatmapKernel.name: HeatmapKernel
HeatmapKernel.description: Radial density-kernel shape. Every kernel, including Gaussian, is evaluated only inside the sample influence radius.

HeatmapNormalize.name: HeatmapNormalize
HeatmapNormalize.description:
How accumulated density gets mapped to the [0, 1] range that drives displacement and color:
- `peak` — divide by the maximum density. Always saturates to 1 at the hottest pixel. Good for relative comparisons.
- `absolute` — caller's `absoluteMax` value is treated as the saturation point. Lets you keep a stable visual reference across data updates.
- `log` — `log1p(d) / log1p(peak)`. Compresses wide-range data so small clusters stay visible next to extreme outliers.

HeatmapCurve.name: HeatmapCurve
HeatmapCurve.description: Curve applied to the normalised density before sampling colour / displacement. Lets you bend the visual response without changing the data: `smoothstep` softens, `cubic` sharpens peaks, `sqrt` brightens mids, `linear` is raw.

HeatmapCountryDomeConfig.name: HeatmapCountryDomeConfig
HeatmapCountryDomeConfig.description:
Country-aware dome bake. When the active kind can provide country polygons and entries include `id` or `name`, each matched sample is rasterized inside that country's polygon instead of spilling as a radial blob over neighbouring countries or oceans.

Tuning the dome shape:
- `centerArea` (≈ 0.3–0.95) — fraction of the country that holds the rounded central crown. Higher = wider plateau, lower = sharper peak.
- `shoulderHeight` (0–1) — height at the crown / wall transition. 1 = crown stays at peak across the entire crown band; 0 = sharp tip.
- `edgeSteepness` (1–5) — exponent applied to the wall falloff. 1 = linear ramp to the boundary, 4+ = sharp cliff just inside the edge.
- `valuePreScale` — see {@link HeatmapValuePreScale}. Default `'log'`.

members.name: enabled
members.description: Defaults to true when the object is supplied. Pass `false` on `countryDomes` to disable.

members.name: centerArea
members.description: Approximate area fraction of the country kept as the rounded central crown. Default 0.55.

members.name: shoulderHeight
members.description: Height at the edge of the central crown before the wall falls down. Default 0.36.

members.name: edgeSteepness
members.description: Extra steepness applied to the falling wall. Default 2.6.

members.name: valuePreScale
members.description: Per-sample value pre-scale — see {@link HeatmapValuePreScale}. Default `'log'`.

members.name: rounding
members.description:
0..1 — how spherical/bubble-like the dome is vs how polygon-shaped.
- 0: pure polygon shape. Contours follow the country outline closely (sharp corners visible, rays reaching toward each polygon vertex).
- 1 (default): pure distance-to-edge field. Contours are smoothly rounded inside the country shape — looks like an irregular bubble.
- middle: linear blend of both. 0.6 keeps the polygon character but files the corners off; 0.9 looks bubble-like with a faint hint of the country's silhouette.

members.name: perCountryNormalize
members.description: Normalize each country dome to the same peak independently of entry value. Disable to retain value magnitude after pre-scaling. Default true.

HeatmapValuePreScale.name: HeatmapValuePreScale
HeatmapValuePreScale.description:
Per-sample value pre-scaling applied **inside** the country dome bake. Lets the per-country dome gradient stay readable when the dataset spans many orders of magnitude (e.g. populations from 0.001M to 1410M). The pre-scale is applied to `entry.value` BEFORE the dome's interior weight is multiplied in, so the gradient inside one country is linear-in-shape even though cross-country comparison is log-compressed.

Use `'log'` (default) when values range over many orders of magnitude, `'sqrt'` for a softer compression, `'linear'` to preserve raw ratios.

HeatmapAnimationStyle.name: HeatmapAnimationStyle
HeatmapAnimationStyle.description: Animation envelope: rise and pop scale height and opacity, fade scales opacity only, and pulse repeats. Pop uses the selected easing; choose a back or elastic easing for overshoot.

HeatmapEasingName.name: HeatmapEasingName
HeatmapEasingName.description: Curve applied to the animation `t∈[0,1]` before it drives displacement scaling and alpha. CSS-style names match their `transition-timing-function` counterparts where applicable; the Penner names follow the de-facto Robert Penner library naming.

HeatmapAnimationOrder.name: HeatmapAnimationOrder
HeatmapAnimationOrder.description:
Order in which entries enter the animation when `stagger > 0`:
- `'sequential'` — input array order (default; cheap, deterministic).
- `'radial'`     — distance from `animation.origin` lat/lng. Cells near the anchor bloom first; great for "spreading wave" effects.
- `'value'`      — descending by aggregated value (top values first).
- `'reverse-value'` — ascending (low values first).
- `'random'`     — shuffled. Looks "spontaneous" / sparkly.
